text: おはな　なんか　いけてる　から　おとなしそうに　みえるが　てごわい　あいてに　なるぞ！

structure.jp: おはな　なんか　いけてる　から
structure.en: because she arranges flowers and such

structure.jp: おとなしそうに　みえるが
てごわい　あいてに　なるぞ！

patterns.name: 〜そうに見える
patterns.span: おとなしそうに　みえる
patterns.explanation: そう added to a describing word means 'seems', and with にみえる it says how someone looks to the eye. おとなしそうに　みえる = 'she looks meek'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に plus なる says what something turns out to be. The ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way to warn someone. てごわい　あいてに　なるぞ = 'she'll be a tough opponent!'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short form of ている, here showing something she does regularly. いけてる = 'she arranges flowers'.
